'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a NPC female Huanglong tourist in [[Capitoline Hill City]]. 
__NOTOC__
{{Dialogue Start}}
==Dialogue==
;(Day)
;'''Lan Hsin''' Grand without sacrificing beauty. Truly the work of a genius...

:'''Lan Hsin:''' Look. Grand without sacrificing beauty. Truly the work of a genius... I've never seen such works before coming to Septimont.
:'''Lan Hsin:''' I've noticed that a lot of art in Septimont depicts muscular people as the subject. There's a beauty inherent in the physical form.
:'''Lan Hsin:''' Seeing these great works, I'm a bit moved... These paintings and sculptures sing praises to the glory of being human... It's truly beautiful.
:'''Lan Hsin:''' Last time I saw a Gladiator's portrait called "Tiny Mirin." But unlike the name, he was painted to be towering and powerful.
----
;(Night)
;'''Lan Hsin''' Grand without sacrificing beauty. Truly the work of a genius...

:'''Lan Hsin:''' I can't believe... Mirin's actually...
:{{DIcon}} Actually what?
:'''Lan Hsin:''' Oh... I saw a Gladiator's portrait called "Tiny Mirin." But unlike the name, he was painted to be towering and powerful.
:'''Lan Hsin:''' Today, I met him and realized that he really is like his name.
:'''Lan Hsin:''' He even said he wanted to promote himself as "small and super-agile," but to his surprise, the artist insisted on giving him muscles and making him buff. It ended up being the total opposite of what he intended...
:'''Lan Hsin:''' Although, I can understand what these works are trying to convey... After all, in the arena, he really is a sight to behold! Truly the work of a genius...
{{Dialogue End}}

==Trivia== 
* The Hanzi characters in her name translate to to Orchid Heart
* The name Mirin has its roots in the Gaelic language, specifically deriving from the word "muirinn," which means "sea-born" or "of the sea."
